items.html: There too it sorts only Behinat Atik de Beria. Atik de Beria is sorted there. AVI de Beria are sorted in Arich, and likewise always because it is impossible for any part to be sorted above the place of its degree, neither in place and nor in time. Instead, they follow one another, both in the order of degrees, and in the order of their time of correction. This is explained sufficiently.
